description: Synthetic, balanced evaluation of conservative automatic skill selection. Use only the request, mode, ready relevant file metadata, and installed skill catalog metadata. Select grounded-document-analysis for a clear owned-document evidence task and video-analysis for a clear owned-video evidence task in auto/fast/deep. Prefer the document-specific skill for document tasks despite overlapping catalog descriptions. Abstain when evidence identity or readiness is unresolved, relevant evidence mixes document and video without an agreed precedence, mode or kind is unsupported, the user negates specialization, or instructions appear only as quoted/document content. Category labels and expected choices are grader data, never selector input. This fixture does not enable runtime selection or imply answer-quality validation.

cases.prompt: Summarize my uploaded operations-notes.pdf and state which sections support the summary.
cases.reason: The user clearly requests evidence-based analysis of one identified, ready uploaded document in a supported mode; prefer the document-specific skill over the broader video description.

cases.prompt: Compare the renewal terms in my uploaded contract-draft.pdf and contract-final.pdf. Attribute every difference to the relevant file.
cases.reason: Both explicitly identified uploaded documents are ready, and a supported-mode comparison requires separate evidence for each document.

cases.prompt: Read the report I attached, quarterly-results.md, and extract its stated revenue totals. Do not estimate missing figures.
cases.reason: The request explicitly asks to retrieve facts from an identified, ready owned document, with missing-evidence handling in a supported mode.

cases.prompt: In my uploaded safety-handbook.pdf, does the inspection schedule contradict the maintenance section? Use evidence from both sections.
cases.reason: One ready uploaded document is unambiguously the evidence source; checking its sections for conflicts fits grounded document analysis.
